overall: The AG resolved by informal action, finding the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notices and create and approve minutes for 2018-2019 meetings, and ordered minutes completed within 90 days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council failed to post meeting notices in Wayland's official notice posting location for meetings held July 1, 2018 to June 30, 2019.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the same was true of the 2018-2019 school year.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council failed to create and approve meeting minutes in a timely manner for meetings held July 1, 2018 to June 30, 2019.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the same was true of the 2018-2019 school year.

remedy: Within 90 days of receipt of this determination, the Council, to the best of its ability, must finish creating meeting minutes for all meetings that took place during the 2018-2019 school year.
remedy_passage: We commend the Council for undertaking these remedial actions and order the Council, to the best of its ability, to finish creating meeting minutes for all meetings that took place during the 2018-2019 school year within 90 days of receipt of this determination.
